```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Read in Excel
RI20_1 <- read_excel("RI_5641_2020_FINAL.xls")

# Filter to only HMS Calls
RI20_1 <- RI20_1 %>%
  filter(Call %in% c("Croak", "Growl", "Whoop"))
head(RI20_1)

# Separate Start.time into Date and Start.time
RI20_1 <- RI20_1 %>%
  mutate(
    `Start datetime` = as.POSIXct(`Start time`, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%OS"),
    Date = format(`Start time`, "%m/%d/%Y"),
    `Start time` = format(`Start datetime`, "%H:%M:%OS")
  )

# Add "Location" variable to RI20_1
RI20_1$Location <- "RI20_1"
```

```{r}
Everything <- rbind(LehuaRock, PHR, FFS, RI20_1, RI20_2, RI21, Kala)

# Add "Hour" variable to Everything
Everything$Hour <- substr(Everything$`Start time`, 1, 2)
Everything$Hour <- gsub(":", "", Everything$Hour)
Everything$Hour <- as.numeric(Everything$Hour)

# Convert 'Call' to numeric (assuming 'Call' represents the number of calls)
Everything$Call = factor(Everything$Call)
Everything$Call_Number <- as.numeric(Everything$Call)

# Call Dictionary
Call_Dictionary = unique(Everything[c('Call', 'Call_Number')])

# First five minutes
Everything$StartMinute = minute(Everything$`Start datetime`)
firstfiveminutes = Everything[Everything$StartMinute < 5,]

```


```{r}
# read in the SoundTrap active .csv
soundtrap_active <- read.csv("ST_active.csv")

# Remove the DataCounmt and .groups columns 
soundtrap_active <- soundtrap_active[, -c(4, 5)]
```

```{r}
# Make the dates work with each other
soundtrap_active$Date <- as.Date(soundtrap_active$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")
firstfiveminutes$Date <- as.Date(firstfiveminutes$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
```

```{r}
# Create the data_counts_by_hour_day data frame
data_counts_by_hour_day <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  group_by(Location, Date, Hour) %>%
  summarize(DataCount = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Merge with the complete set and replace missing values with 0
data_counts_by_hour_day <- soundtrap_active %>%
  left_join(data_counts_by_hour_day, by = c("Hour", "Date", "Location")) %>%
  replace_na(list(DataCount = 0))

# look at the times with the most calls
head(data_counts_by_hour_day[order(data_counts_by_hour_day$DataCount, decreasing=T), ], 25)

# Calculate the total number of unique hours analyzed for each deployment
hours_per_deployment <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  distinct(Location, Date, Hour) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarize(Total_Hours = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Calculate the total number of minutes analyzed for each deployment
hours_per_deployment <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  distinct(Location, Date, Hour) %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarize(Total_Hours = n(), .groups = 'drop')

minutes_per_deployment <- hours_per_deployment %>%
  mutate(Total_Minutes = Total_Hours * 5)

print(minutes_per_deployment)

```

```{r}
# Average number of calls per hour across all days across all locations
average_calls_per_hour <- aggregate(DataCount ~ Hour, mean, data=data_counts_by_hour_day)
```


```{r}
# Create the average_calls_per_hour data frame for all locations
average_calls_per_hour_location <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  group_by(Location, Hour) %>%
  summarize(AverageDataCount = mean(DataCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Print the resulting data frame
print(average_calls_per_hour_location)

# find the max vocalization count in a 5-min period
max_calling_rate <- max(data_counts_by_hour_day$DataCount, na.rm = TRUE)

# find the site the max vocal count occurred
peak_calling_period <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  filter(DataCount == max_calling_rate)

print(peak_calling_period)
```

```{r}
# Graph of average calls per hour across all days by location

# Colorblind friendly palette:
# cbPalette <- c("#000000", "#009E73", "#56B4E9", "#E69F00", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")


# Colors that match my map figure and table 1
cbPalette <- c("#6BD3FF", "#70FB76", "#008B8D", "#FF726C", "#490F8D", "#9131FF", "#D67DFF")

# Ensure Location is a factor with distinct levels
average_calls_per_hour_location$Location <- factor(average_calls_per_hour_location$Location)

# Define distinct shapes for each location
shape_values <- c(18, 3, 16, 7, 17, 19, 15)  # Assign different shapes to avoid overlap

g <- ggplot(
  average_calls_per_hour_location, 
  aes(Hour, AverageDataCount, color = Location, shape = Location)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Adjust size for better visibility
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(title = "Average Calls Per Hour", y = "Average Number of Calls", x = "Hour") +   
  scale_colour_manual(values = cbPalette) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values)  # Apply distinct shapes to each location

ggsave("temporalplots_distinct_shapes.png", g, width = 8.5, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)

```


```{r}
# Creating dataframe that includes sd of frequency of calls per hour
df.summary <- data_counts_by_hour_day %>%
  group_by(Location, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    sd = sd(DataCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    DataCount = mean(DataCount)
  )
df.summary

# Graph of average calls per hour across all days with error bars
ggplot(df.summary, aes(x = Hour, y = DataCount, color = Location)) +
geom_line() + 
geom_point() +
 geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = DataCount-sd, ymax = DataCount+sd), width = 0.2) + labs(title = "Average Calls Per Hour", y = "Average Number of Calls", x = "Hour") + facet_wrap( ~ Location)
```

```{r}
# Creating a table of number of calls/call type at each site for the first five min analyzed
library(tidyr)

# Group by Call and Location, and summarize the total number of calls for each combination
call_type_location_table <- CallCounts %>%
  group_by(Call, Location) %>%
  summarise(total_calls = sum(DataCount), .groups = 'drop')  # Summarize the number of calls per Call and Location

# Reshape the data so that Call types are rows and Locations are columns
call_type_location_table_wide <- call_type_location_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Location, values_from = total_calls, values_fill = list(total_calls = 0))  # Fill missing values with 0

# View the final table
print(call_type_location_table_wide)

# Save the table as a CSV file
write.csv(call_type_location_table_wide, "firstfivemin_call_type_location_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Creating a table of number of calls/call type at each site for Everything analyzed (not just the first five minutes)
everything_table <- Everything %>%
  group_by(Call, Location) %>%
  summarise(total_calls = n(), .groups = 'drop')  # Summarize the number of calls (counting rows for each Call and Location)

# Reshape the data so that Call types are rows and Locations are columns
everything_table_wide <- everything_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Location, values_from = total_calls, values_fill = list(total_calls = 0))  # Fill missing values with 0

# Save the table as a CSV file
write.csv(everything_table_wide, "everything_call_type_location_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Create figure for diel patterns of top four call types

# Define the vocal types to include in the plot
selected_calls <- c("Croak", "Growl", "Moan", "Whoop")

# Summarize total calls per hour for the selected vocal types, grouped by location
filtered_diel_patterns <- firstfiveminutes %>%
  filter(Call %in% selected_calls) %>%
  group_by(Hour, Call, Location) %>%
  summarise(TotalCalls = n(), .groups = 'drop')  # Count the number of calls

# Define the custom color palette with updated colors
custom_palette <- c("FFS" = "#6BD3FF", "PHR" = "#FF726C", "LehuaRock" = "#008B8D", 
                    "RI20_2" = "#D67DFF", "RI21" = "#490F8D", "Kala" = "#70FB76")

# Ensure the legend order AND stacking order match: FFS at top, Kala at bottom
filtered_diel_patterns$Location <- factor(filtered_diel_patterns$Location, 
                                          levels = c("Kala", "RI21", "RI20_2", "LehuaRock", "PHR", "FFS"))  # Order for stacking (bottom to top)

# Create the stacked bar plot with flexible y-axis for each call type
ggplot(filtered_diel_patterns, aes(x = Hour, y = TotalCalls, fill = Location)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +  # Stacked bars to show location contribution
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Diel Patterns of Selected Vocal Types by Location",
       x = "Hour of the Day",
       y = "Total Calls per Five-Minute Interval",
       fill = "Location") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 3)) +  # Tick marks every 3 hours
  facet_wrap(~ Call, scales = "free_y") +  # ALLOW DIFFERENT Y-AXIS LIMITS FOR EACH VOCAL TYPE
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +  # Match legend order
  theme(legend.position = "right")  # Ensure legend placement

# Save the plot
ggsave("diel_patterns_stacked_barplot_corrected_colors.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600)

```
